US President Donald Trump says his offer of talks with Iran are the 'last chance'. Tehran says there are no talks with the US, but discussions with Oman to get more ships moving through the Strait of Hormuz are making progress.

Today's guests: Georges Elhedery, HSBC Group CEO; Viki Farmaki, State Street Investment Management, Senior Equity Research Analyst & Jason Quinn, Nedbank, CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Morocco’s government said factors such as misinformation and human trafficking lured tens of thousands of migrants into illegally crossing into the Spanish-governed northern African enclave of Ceuta last week. Meanwhile, Spain’s foreign minister said nearly everyone who illegally crossed into Ceuta has left as it tries to assure its European Union neighbors that it is swiftly returning the roughly 50,000 undocumented migrants. Bloomberg's Jennifer Zabasajja reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Ukraine Deploys Killer Robots to Narrow Manpower Gap With Russia

summary: When a group of Russian assault troops approached Ukrainian defenses on a section of the front line in eastern Donetsk, they were met by an unexpected adversary: a battle robot armed with a flamethrower.
